description: Set transaction_direction for inbound transactions and normalize amount_cents formatting

set.description: Set transaction_direction to outbound for specific number and transaction_type conditions
set.if: ctx.number != null && ctx.number instanceof Number && ctx.number >= 34996 && ctx.number <= 35000 && ctx.transaction_type != null && ['cash','international','eft'].contains(ctx.transaction_type)

set.description: Set transaction_direction to inbound for specific number and transaction_type conditions
set.if: ctx.number != null && ctx.number instanceof Number && ctx.number >= 34996 && ctx.number <= 35000 && ctx.transaction_type != null && ['card','mobile','online'].contains(ctx.transaction_type)

script.description: Zero-pad amount_cents if between 0 and 9 for days
script.source: if (ctx.containsKey('day') && ctx.day != null) { def raw = ctx.day; int n = -1; if (raw instanceof Number) { n = ((Number)raw).intValue(); } else if (raw instanceof String) { try { n = Integer.parseInt(raw); } catch (Exception e) { n = -1; } } if (n >= 0 && n <= 9) { ctx.day = '0' + n; } }

script.description: Zero-pad amount_cents if between 0 and 9 for cents
script.source: if (ctx.containsKey('cents') && ctx.cents != null) { def raw = ctx.cents; int n = -1; if (raw instanceof Number) { n = ((Number)raw).intValue(); } else if (raw instanceof String) { try { n = Integer.parseInt(raw); } catch (Exception e) { n = -1; } } if (n >= 0 && n <= 9) { ctx.cents = '0' + n; } }
